component.name: less-sheet
component.summary: Open huge CSV and Parquet files instantly

description.p: A native, read-only tabular data viewer for CSV, CSV.gz and Parquet files, opened locally or over HTTP(S).
It reads only what is needed to show the table, keeping startup fast and memory use bounded even for very large files.

ul.li: Find, filter and jump across the whole file without loading it
Change the separator, quoting and encoding on the fly
Read gzipped CSV without unpacking it first
Open HTTP(S) URLs, using byte ranges when available
Copy cells, rows or a filtered view to the clipboard

description.p: It never writes to the files you open, sends no telemetry, and needs no account.

screenshot.caption: Filtering a large CSV without loading it
Choosing the separator and quoting for a file

description.p: Added local and HTTP(S) Parquet support with bounded page decoding.
Added Check for Updates to the app menu.
Refreshed native GTK layout with compact controls, clearer tables, and smoother animations using OpenGL rendering.
Drop a file into the window to open it. Repeated searches and filters reuse previous scan progress, including navigation in sorted views.

Sort by any column, ascending or descending, from the column header's menu or with a keyboard shortcut. The first sorted rows appear at once and refine while the file is scanned; memory stays flat, with the sort's working data kept in temporary files.
Faster launch: the window opens in about a third of the time, and memory at rest is lower.
